verdict.rationale: Smooth's documented model is a hosted cloud browser accessed through its API and CLI. Its localhost feature only tunnels traffic from that remote browser to your machine ('P2P tunnel through your machine… enabling access to localhost'). That is an adjacent capability, not running the agent against a local browser without a cloud account. Community comments note that it does not run on users' machines and ask for self-hosting, and no evidence shows a local-browser or account-free mode.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a local browser on my own machine for development, without any cloud account
